run_metadata.coverage_summary: DEGRADED RUN (network-limited), consistent with recent prior runs. The environment's egress proxy blocked ALL WebFetch/HTTP requests this run — every host returned EGRESS_BLOCKED, including Tier 1 government portals (tenders.gov.au, tenders.nsw.gov.au, vendorpanel.com.au). Per the agent-proxy README this is an organisation egress-policy denial (selective=false, arbitrary hosts blocked), not a TLS/config fault, so it is reported rather than worked around. Only the WebSearch tool was functional. WebSearch returns result titles, deep-link URLs and a short synthesised snippet, but does NOT allow opening a tender's own detail page, following RSS/JSON feeds, paginating a portal, or reading tender documents. Consequently NO deliverables/requirements/document extraction was possible: every opportunity below is captured at headline level only and flagged entries_pending_detail. Where a real portal deep-link URL and reference/ID were returned by the search engine, the tender's existence and identifier are captured; the subject, dates, buyer detail and scope remain unread. Tier 1 (AusTender current ATMs, buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria, NT QTOL, Sydney Water GBE) surfaced ID-bearing deep links. Tier 3 (SAP Ariba Discovery, major-buyer portals) showed no publicly-visible RFx — all corporate RFx were login/registration-gated, as expected; portals recorded in discovered_sources, none fabricated. One genuinely new buyer-originated source (Orica — Supplying to Orica, SAP Ariba Sourcing) was identified. This run is not representative of live volume; the majority of open opportunities across all tiers could not be reached.
gaps: CRITICAL: All WebFetch/egress was blocked by the environment network policy this run. Every URL fetched returned EGRESS_BLOCKED, including a Tier 1 gov portal (www.tenders.gov.au) and a platform (www.vendorpanel.com.au) tested directly. The agent-proxy status reported selective=false with only package registries in noProxy, confirming a broad org egress denial rather than a TLS/config issue. Only WebSearch was functional.

Detail/deliverables extraction impossible for every entry: no tender detail page or document could be opened. All commercial, requirement, eligibility, evaluation-criteria, contact and document fields are null and require an authenticated / egress-enabled follow-up pass.

Tier 1 core portals could not be read directly (AusTender, buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria, QTenders/supply.qld, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders). Only what surfaced in WebSearch result blocks / snippets could be captured, at headline level.

South Australia (Tenders SA) again returned South-African 'Tenders-SA' noise mixed with the SA portal; no individually identifiable South Australian open tender (title+id) could be isolated. SA deferred to a future run.

Western Australia, Tasmania and ACT surfaced only portal/search-interface pages this run — no individually identifiable open tender with a title+id could be captured. ACT search snippet indicated no recently-added ACT tenders at the time of the run.

The two NSW buy.nsw entries (Swansea Bridge asset upgrade; Fire System Maintenance Northern & Coffs Harbour Tunnels) were reconstructed from a WebSearch synthesised snippet, NOT from a discrete result-block deep link or a readable detail page. Their titles, buyers and closing dates are unverified and must be re-checked on the next egress-enabled run before being relied upon.

AusTender ATM entries carry the reference/ID and a real 'Current ATM View' deep-link URL returned by the search engine, but the subject title, agency, category and dates could not be read (detail page egress-blocked).

Tier 3 corporate: SAP Ariba Discovery and major-buyer portals (BHP, Rio Tinto, Woolworths, Coles, Qantas, banks, telcos, Orica, Ampol, South32) showed no publicly-visible RFx via WebSearch — opportunities are registration- or invitation-gated. Portals recorded in discovered_sources; no corporate opportunity fabricated. Invitation-only consultancy RFPs remain out of scope.
Construction subcontract (EstimateOne, iTWOcx, BidContender): only platform-level information visible; individual builder work-packages are behind free supplier login and could not be read.
recommended_seed_additions: Orica — Supplying to Orica (https://www.orica.com/supplying-to-orica): buyer-originated corporate explosives/mining-chemicals supplier portal; suppliers respond to quotations and bids via SAP Ariba Sourcing (free platform). Not previously in the known-source list.

Ampol — Procurement Portal (https://procurement.ampol.com.au/web/login.html) and https://www.ampol.com.au/about-ampol/procurement: login-gated corporate procurement portal (already broadly known; confirm coverage).

Ramsay Health Care — Vendor Portal (https://ramsayhealthcare.outsystemsenterprise.com/vendor/): private-health vendor portal, primarily AP/document submission rather than open RFx advertising — monitor for sourcing events.
